name: The Kitchen Table
description: Recurring American Mahjong open play and beginner classes at The Kitchen Table. Current fall schedule includes multiple October and November open-play dates, and players use the current NMJL card.
schedule: Open play generally Mondays 6:00-8:30 PM; additional lunch and beginner-class sessions are scheduled.

name: Beth Meyer Synagogue Mah Jongg Meet-Up
description: Weekly Sunday drop-in Mah Jongg in the synagogue library; beginners are welcome and the organizer asks players to bring an American Mah Jongg set and National Mah Jongg League card.
schedule: Sundays 10:00 AM-12:00 PM while religious school is in session; upcoming dates include October 11, 18, 25 and November 1, 8, 15, 22, 2026.

name: Mahj With R+M
description: Raleigh Mahjong community with recurring Monday open play at BottleRev3. Current listings show multiple October 2026 sessions and require players to bring NMJL cards.
schedule: Mahj Mondays at BottleRev3, Mondays 6:30-8:30 PM; October 5, 12, 19 and 26, 2026 are listed as open.

name: Wake-Up N' Mahj Social Club
description: American Mahjong social club serving Wake County with many day and evening drop-in games and Mahjong 101 prerequisites.
schedule: Many day and evening games per week across Wake County, but the main site does not expose enough exact current session details for a public ACTIVE listing.
